note: The first full install, end to end, on any system of the library: from 'install Jupylet' in the code folder to the spaceship running. It starts after the download and the move to the code folder, because the skills appearing at the end of a turn can only be tested in a real session. The system is mac-miniconda-terminal, or the one given with --system, for example win-miniconda. The checks name the steps by the tags of their commands, so they work on macOS and on Windows; a check with 'platform' applies to that platform only. The persona and the system add their own checks. max_actions is per worker turn. Replaces full-install-miniconda.json (runs full-install-miniconda-1 and real-T8).
